exhibits.title: Windows Forensic Automation
exhibits.desc: Load a disk image, pick the type of case, and get answers, every parsed artifact and a court-ready report.

exhibits.title: Connected Phone Forensics
exhibits.desc: Find every phone that was connected to a computer, what it left there, and exactly where each fact came from.

exhibits.title: PhonePe Forensics
exhibits.desc: A local DFIR workstation for PhonePe iOS extractions: cross-database correlation, unified timeline and UPI fraud hunting.

exhibits.title: VSCExplorer
exhibits.desc: Find, mount and browse Volume Shadow Copies inside E01 and RAW images — BitLocker-encrypted ones included.

exhibits.title: DFIR Agent Builder
exhibits.desc: A desktop wizard that compiles one self-contained Rust triage collector, ready to push to thousands of endpoints by GPO.

exhibits.title: DFIR Autopilot
exhibits.desc: Extracts, parses and analyses Windows artifacts with pluggable agents and a local LLM, then writes the case report.
